shared_elements: relief carving of figures in low/high relief on a curved surface
justification: Both surfaces carry raised relief with what appear to be limb-like or anthropomorphic forms wrapping over a rounded surface, which is the only correspondence and a very generic one. A shows a legible frieze of several repeated human figures in active poses with arms raised, arranged in a horizontal register, whereas B shows a single dominant rounded boss with spiral/curvilinear elements and no comparable repeated procession of figures or register organisation.
